verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents its own programmatic APIs for voice, SMS, messaging, video, fax, data and system configuration. It also ships official JavaScript, Java and .NET SDKs, and its docs cover creating auth credentials and making API calls, so the product can be driven without its UI. Nothing in the pack shows a headless CLI, CI integration guidance, or a non-interactive auth flow. The permissions doc says scopes are 'confirmed by the user during the authorization stage', and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD usage, a non-interactive service-account or JWT auth flow, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
